newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MANILA BOURSE TO SIGN ACCORD ON SMALL FIRMS' BOARD.
newsitem.headline: MANILA BOURSE TO SIGN ACCORD ON SMALL FIRMS' BOARD.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) is set to sign a memorandum of agreement setting guidelines for the creation of a small and medium enterprises (SME) trading board, C & P Homes Inc chairman Manuel Villar said.

Villar, who has been pressing for the setting up of facilities under which small companies could be listed, said the agreement will give the Philippine bourse and small firms 60 days to decide on how to operate the trading board.

The PSE is pushing for the creation of a SME board in the exchange in order to save on operating costs, while the Small Business Guarantee Fund Corp, a government financing body aimed at helping SMEs, wants a separate exchange.
The SME board will list qualified companies with capital of at least 10 million pesos.
